bullets.text: Residents in Pallikaranai fear floods due to a controversial retaining wall around the marshland, and the office should monitor the project's justification.
Minjur residents blocked roads at night to protest extended power cuts, and the office should watch local electricity supply stability.
A 19-year-old was murdered near Ponneri with his body buried near Pulicat, prompting police to detain suspects, and the office should track the investigation.
Omron Healthcare opened its first India manufacturing facility in Gummidipoondi near Chennai, and the office should support further industrial investments.
Police formed seven special teams to apprehend a rowdy gang in Thiruvallur, and the office should track law and order updates.
Tamil Nadu launched a WhatsApp and AI-based complaint system for water, garbage, and streetlights, and the office should monitor civic adoption.
Digital Bharat Nidhi signed a utilisation agreement to boost broadband access in Tamil Nadu, and the office should watch digital infrastructure rollout.
Karnataka's minister urged IT professionals to adapt to AI-driven changes, and the office should track skilling initiatives in the sector.
The Tamil Nadu government sanctioned 2,200 infrastructure projects focusing on roads and water supply, and the office should oversee implementation progress.
